_comment: The CLOSED ALPHABET every string value in a committed replay fixture must belong to (restructure spec §5.6 rule 2). Match literals exactly or patterns with fullmatch. Synthetic construction against tests/mock_pms.py remains required: membership is a vocabulary check, not proof of data provenance, and cannot distinguish private values coincidentally equal to allowed words/numbers. CLI, outbound guard and host tests share this policy. Add new protocol constants by source-backed name, never by harvesting an unchecked recording.

_sources.controlled_content: app/bootstrap/effects.rs and bootstrap/stores.rs name content/metadata; metadata.rs MarkerKind/RatingArt; person.rs seed_dev_credits and filmography name the finite departments. tests/mock_pms.py builds people thumb paths, plex GUIDs from sname, two-sname mkv filenames, a four-sname tagline and en/eng/srt/mkv media values.
_sources.effect_and_machine_names: rust-modules/src/app/recorder.rs: Recplay::effect Fx match and machine_name exhaustive MachineId match
_sources.provenance: rust-modules/src/ui/present.rs: Provenance/ResourceKind; ui/machine.rs: MachineId and derived Debug InstanceId/StoreOrd/TimerId; ui/fixture.rs: Recorder::present formats Debug. Landing(Instance(4)) is NOT that format.
_sources.routes: rust-modules/src/app/words.rs: route_word, overlay_suffix and NO_OVERLAY; app/recorder.rs: AppInit::probe; screens/registry.rs word constants; screens/player/overlay.rs: OverlayKind names menu/info/chapters/more
_sources.trigger_subset: rust-modules/src/dev.rs: DIAG rec/focus/noidle, read(nowan); dev/scenarios.rs: token/settings/detail/detailsec/detailok/filmography; person.rs: personcredits. armed_triggers records filenames, never arbitrary =contents. This is a reviewed subset, not all possible runtime filenames.
_sources.commands: rust-modules/src/app/events.rs: ck/pat/txt dispatch; ui/testpat.rs: set finite pattern names and numeric argument structure; txt replaces plus with spaces, so only synthetic words are allowed (not hexadecimal credentials). Numeric patterns intentionally accept a subset of float syntax.

_sources.record_vocabulary: rust-modules/src/ui/rec.rs: Writer record tags; ui/fixture.rs and ui/screen.rs: input/lifecycle names; app/recorder.rs: feature names and probes
_sources.controlled_home: app/bootstrap.rs: Initial::synthetic_home fixes loopback, emits the complete Seeded contract and a fixed probe; app/bootstrap/effects.rs explicitly encodes input Source/Key/Edge, lifecycle By, Home commands and store request names. auth/owner.rs declares ActivateDevBootstrap and ReadyInstall::AlreadyInstalled; auth.rs Phase::Idle and Picker::Boot, plex/probe.rs Location's lowercase local wire. No general UUID, hostname, token or capitalized-word pattern is permitted.
